scope: Location selection metadata only. No procedure, integration, boundary, geocoding or live-intake coverage is established by inclusion.
exclusions: Only the 444 municipal corporations present in the official registry are directory options.
Northern geographic districts are not added as upper-tier municipal corporations.
Unorganized territories, First Nations reserves, neighbourhoods and other communities absent from this municipality registry remain available through the existing manual-location fallback.
